object_description: lightweight upper volume on a solid base with a modulated roofscape
design_condition: Offset westward from the existing building, the volume enlarges the entrance area, maintains distance from the outdoor pools, and forms shaded, sunken, and embanked outdoor spaces around the bathing complex.

positive.statement: The new building integrates into the existing situation and connects seamlessly to the existing site.

position.rationale: The westward offset and surrounding ground-level edges indicate the site connection.

positive.statement: The modulated roof landscape and facade design with its choice of materials and fenestration are impressive.

position.rationale: The stepped upper volume and modulated roof outline are clearly visible in plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The operational processes are well resolved and the bathroom floor is spatially structured in an appealing way.

position.rationale: The main lower volume provides a constrained anchor for the internal bathing floor.

positive.statement: The arrangement of the pools is ideal from the user's perspective.

position.rationale: Pool layouts are internal, so the marker uses the central lower-volume zone.

positive.statement: The covered intermediate zone supports the desired indoor-outdoor connection.

position.rationale: The lower transition zone is anchored along the visible interface between base and upper volume.

positive.statement: The relatively small area and volume promise comparatively low construction costs, and the wooden construction is a first step toward sustainability.

position.rationale: Construction material is not separable in the point cloud; the marker references the lightweight upper structure.

negative.statement: The measures intended to upgrade the traffic area into a square could be stronger and more effective spatially.
